Intel quickhack · ◆ Quiet · DV8 · Cooldown 10 Rounds · 1 slot

For 20 Rounds you see every Neuroport, camera and networked device within 20m of the target, through walls, and can Jack In to any of them without line of sight. Range still applies.

Interface + 1d10 vs DV8. 500eb (Expensive). Cyberpunk: The Unification Era, Core Rules Chapter 10.
